package codegen

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/light-speak/luxo/pkg/ast"
)

type facadeFixtureShape struct {
	name     string
	decimal  bool
	writable bool
}

func (shape facadeFixtureShape) fields() []*ast.FieldDecl {
	valueType := "Int"
	if shape.decimal {
		valueType = "Decimal"
	}
	return []*ast.FieldDecl{
		testField("id", "Int", directive("id")),
		{Name: "legacy"},
		testField("value", valueType),
	}
}

func facadeFixtureShapes() []facadeFixtureShape {
	return []facadeFixtureShape{
		{"R", false, false}, {"User", false, true},
		{"Report", true, false}, {"Invoice", true, true},
		{"A" + strings.Repeat("a", 256), false, false},
		{"B" + strings.Repeat("b", 256), false, true},
		{"C" + strings.Repeat("c", 319), true, false},
		{"D" + strings.Repeat("d", 319), true, true},
	}
}

func BenchmarkQueryFacadeLongIdentifier(b *testing.B) {
	for _, shape := range []struct {
		label string
		value facadeFixtureShape
	}{
		{"RegularReadOnly", facadeFixtureShapes()[4]},
		{"RegularWritable", facadeFixtureShapes()[5]},
		{"DecimalReadOnly", facadeFixtureShapes()[6]},
		{"DecimalWritable", facadeFixtureShapes()[7]},
	} {
		b.Run(shape.label, func(b *testing.B) {
			fields := shape.value.fields()
			b.ReportAllocs()
			for b.Loop() {
				var output strings.Builder
				defaultGenerator().generateQueryFacade(&output, shape.value.name, fields, shape.value.writable)
				if output.Len() == 0 {
					b.Fatal("missing query facade")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
